root@061d2cdf5ea7:/app# cat > /app/analyze6.py << 'EOF'
> import PIL
> from PIL import Image
>
> def get_square_color(x, y):
>     square = img.crop((x, y, x+80, y+80))
>     pixels = list(square.getdata())
>     total = len(pixels)
>     avg_r = sum(p[0] for p in pixels) / total
>     avg_g = sum(p[1] for p in pixels) / total
>     avg_b = sum(p[2] for p in pixels) / total
>     return avg_r, avg_g, avg_b
>
> img = Image.open('/app/chess_puzzle.png')
> # Store piece positions
> white_pos = []
> black_pos = []
> for y in range(0, 640, 80):
>     for x in range(0, 640, 80):
>         r,g,b = get_square_color(x, y)
>         # Determine if it's a piece square (i.e., not uniform)
>         if abs(r - g) < 10 and abs(g - b) < 10:
>             continue
>         # Simple color assignment: if the average RGB is less than 150, it's dark (black)
>         avg = (r + g + b) / 3
>         if avg < 150:
>             black_pos.append((x, y))
>         else:
>             white_pos.append((x, y))
> print('White pieces:', white_pos)
> print('Black pieces:', black_pos)
> # Try to find a move for each white piece that captures a black piece
> for (wx, wy) in white_pos:
>     # Check adjacent squares (8x8 grid)
>     for (bx, by) in black_pos:
>         # Check if they are adjacent (difference of 1 in the 8x8 grid)
>         if abs((wx - 80) // 80 - (bx - 80) // 80) <= 1 and abs((wy - 80) // 80 - (by - 80) // 80) <= 1:
>             # This is a potential capture move
>             # We'll try to see if there is a valid move from (wx,wy) to (bx,by)
>             # We'll need to know the piece type. We'll assume it's a simple move.
>             # We'll output the move.
>             src = f'{wx//80}{wy//80}'
>             dst = f'{bx//80}{by//80}'
>             print(f'Move: {src}{dst}')
>             # We'll break out after the first capture
>             break
>     else:
>         continue
>     break
> EOF

>
> def square_to_notation(square):
>     # square is a tuple (x, y) where x and y are multiples of 80
>     # Convert to 0-63
>     idx = (square[0] // 80) + (square[1] // 80) * 8
>     file = idx % 8
>     rank = idx // 8
>     # Convert file to letter
>     file_char = 'abcdefgh'[file]
>     rank_str = str(rank + 1)
>     return f'{file_char}{rank_str}'
>
> def get_square_color(x, y):
>     square = img.crop((x, y, x+80, y+80))
>     pixels = list(square.getdata())
>     total = len(pixels)
>     avg_r = sum(p[0] for p in pixels) / total
>     avg_g = sum(p[1] for p in pixels) / total
>     avg_b = sum(p[2] for p in pixels) / total
>     return avg_r, avg_g, avg_b
>
> img = Image.open('/app/chess_puzzle.png')
> white_pos = []
> black_pos = []
> for y in range(0, 640, 80):
>     for x in range(0, 640, 80):
>         r,g,b = get_square_color(x, y)
>         if abs(r - g) < 10 and abs(g - b) < 10:
>             continue
>         avg = (r + g + b) / 3
>         if avg < 150:
>             black_pos.append((x, y))
>         else:
>             white_pos.append((x, y))
>
> moves = []
> for (wx, wy) in white_pos:
>     for (bx, by) in black_pos:
>         if abs((wx - 80) // 80 - (bx - 80) // 80) <= 1 and abs((wy - 80) // 80 - (by - 80) // 80) <= 1:
>             src = square_to_notation((wx, wy))
>             dst = square_to_notation((bx, by))
>             moves.append((src, dst))
>             break
>
> with open('/app/move.txt', 'w') as f:
>     for src, dst in moves:
>         f.write(f'{src}{dst}\n')
>
> print('Converted moves written to /app/move.txt')
> EOF
